description: These two linked urbisphere London deposits supply inputs for building energy and anthropogenic heat modelling: activity profiles derived from the UK Time Use Survey 2014-15 (UR-2), and thermal and radiative parameters of building elements for UK building typologies (UR-4). They were published on Zenodo on 28 March 2024 by University of Reading urban meteorology and built environment researchers including Megan McGrory, Denise Hertwig, Samuele Lo Piano, Yiqing Liu, Heidi Llanwarne, Matthew Paskin, Stefan T. Smith and Sue Grimmond. UR-2 holds activity profile CSVs, appliance power information, auxiliary data and Python code; UR-4 holds layer-specific and effective parameters for external walls, roofs, ground floors, windows, internal walls and floors, the uBEMM spreadsheet tool and code, drawing on TABULA typologies for the STEBBS model. Coverage: London and UK building types. Access: Zenodo, but files were embargoed when read. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 once released. Caveats: embargoed files; documentation PDFs are part of each deposit. Simulation uses: agent-based anthropogenic heat models and building energy exchange models in urban climate studies (APEx, ASSURE). Related records: OccDem and the Sydney urban form data.
